name: Onegai
source:
Main character is a very ordinary young man from a preparatory school. One day a pretty girl from the same class asks a huge "request" from him - to make love with her. As training goes on with every week secrets of the girl start to shop up. Mysterious organization preys on her, and balance should be executed in training to satisfy the organization and not to harm the girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主角是预备校里一名再普通不过的年轻人。一天，同班一名漂亮女孩向他提出一个不得了的「请求」：和她做爱。随着每周训练的进行，女孩的秘密开始逐渐浮现。一个神秘组织觊觎着她；为了既满足组织又不伤害女孩，训练必须谨慎把握分寸。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
